description: This file defines the ProcedureParameter interface for Spark SQL connector procedures, including nested classes and enums for parameter modes and building procedure parameters.

classes.name: ProcedureParameter
classes.description: Interface representing a procedure parameter with methods to access parameter properties and a nested Builder class for construction.

classes.name: ProcedureParameter.Mode
classes.description: Enum representing the modes of procedure parameters: IN, INOUT, OUT.

classes.name: ProcedureParameter.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ProcedureParameter instances with optional default values and comments.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Static method to create a builder for an IN mode procedure parameter.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the parameter.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the parameter.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value expression or null if not set.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the parameter or null if not set.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Builder method to set default value using SQL string.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Builder method to set default value using an Expression.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Builder method to set default value directly.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Builder method to set a comment for the parameter.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ProcedureParameter instance.
